Name: Moving Target Report Version B
Description: The Moving Target Report Version B (MTIRPB) TRE is an optional extension that provides a standard format to report moving targets located by the radar system.

MTI_DP.Name: Destination Point
MTI_DP.Description: This field contains the destination point at which the scene was collected.

MTI_PACKET_ID.Name: MTI Packet ID Number
MTI_PACKET_ID.Description: This field contains the ID number of the MTI packet.

PATCH_NO.Name: Patch Number
PATCH_NO.Description: This field contains the number of the patch within which the targets of this report are located.

WAMTI_FRAME_NO.Name: Wide Area MTI Frame Number
WAMTI_FRAME_NO.Description: This field contains the number of the Frame within which the targets of this report were located. This field is only used with the Wide Area MTI mode.

WAMTI_BAR_NO.Name: Wide Area MTI Bar Number
WAMTI_BAR_NO.Description: This field contains the number of the Wide Area Bar within which the targets of this report were located. This field is only used with the Wide Area MTI mode.

DATIME.Name: Scan Date and Time
DATIME.Description: This field shall contain the date and time, referenced to UTC, when the targets identified in this report were scanned by the sensor. The value of this field shall have the format CCYYMMDDhhmmss, CCYY is the year, MM is the month (01-12), DD is the day of the month (01-31), hh is the hour (00-23), mm is the minute (00-59), and ss is the seconds (00-59).

ACFT_LOC.Name: Aircraft Location
ACFT_LOC.Description: This field contains the aircraft position when the sensor scanned the targets identified in this report. The format ddmmss.ssX represents degrees (00-89), minutes (00-59), seconds (00-59), and hundredths of seconds (00-59) of latitude with X = N for north or S for south, and dddmmss.ssY represents degrees (000-179), minutes (00-59), seconds (00-59), and hundredths of seconds (00-59) of longitude with Y = E for east or W for west. The format +/-dd.dddddd indicates degrees of latitude (north is positive) and +/-ddd.dddddd represents degrees of longitude (east is positive).

ACFT_ALT.Name: Aircraft Altitude
ACFT_ALT.Description: This field describes the altitude of the aircraft in feet above mean sea level (MSL) at the UTC of the Patch.

ACFT_ALT_UNIT.Name: Unit of Aircraft Altitude
ACFT_ALT_UNIT.Description: This field shall contain the unit of the aircraft altitude, field ACFT_ALT. The value f = feet and m = meters.

ACFT_HEADING.Name: Aircraft Heading
ACFT_HEADING.Description: This field shall contain the heading of the aircraft in degrees.

MTI_LR.Name: MTI L/R
MTI_LR.Description: This field shall contain the side of the aircraft from which the MTI information is gathered. The value R = right and L = left.

SQUINT_ANGLE.Name: Squint Angle
SQUINT_ANGLE.Description: This field contains the angle measured in degrees from crosstrack (broadside) to the great circle joining the ground point directly below the Aircraft Reference Point (ARP) to the Output Reference Point (ORP). Forward looking squint angles range from +00.00 (broadside) to +85.00 degrees; aft looking squint angles range from -00.00 to -60.00 degrees.

COSGRZ.Name: Cosine of Graze Angle
COSGRZ.Description: This field contains the cosine of the angle between the radar line of sight (from antenna at mid collection array to the CCRP) and a plane tangent to the geoid at CCRP. A value of 9.99999 = unknown.

NO_VALID_TGTS.Name: Number of MTI Targets
NO_VALID_TGTS.Description: This field contains the number of MTI targets within this extension. This field determines the number of occurrences of TGT_LOC, TGT_LOC_ACCY, TGT_VEL_R, TGT_SPEED, TGT_HEADING, TGT_AMPLITUDE, and TGT_CAT fields.

TGT_LOC<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Location
TGT_LOC<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field contains the target location. The format ddmmss.ssX represents degrees (00 to 89), minutes (00 to 59), seconds (00 to 59), and hundredths of seconds (00 to 99) of latitude with X = N for north or S for south, and dddmmss.ssY represents degrees (00 to 179), minutes (00 to 59), seconds (00 to 59), and hundredths of seconds (00 to 99) of longitude with Y = E for east or W for west.

TGT_LOC_ACCY<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Location Accuracy
TGT_LOC_ACCY<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field contains the approximate 90% probable circular error value. The value of 000000 or 000.00 represents unknown.

TGT_VEL_R<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Radial Velocity
TGT_VEL_R<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field contains the target radial velocity. A positive value indicates target n is moving away from the sensor, and a negative value indicates target n is moving towards the sensor.

TGT_SPEED<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Estimated Ground Speed
TGT_SPEED<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field shall contain the target estimated ground speed in feet/second.

TGT_HEADING<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Heading
TGT_HEADING<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field contains the direction that the nth target is moving rounded to the nearest degree and referenced to True North. 000 = North, 090 = East, 180 = South, and 270 = West.

TGT_AMPLITUDE<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Name: Target Signal Amplitude
TGT_AMPLITUDE<NO_VALID_TGTS>.Description: This field contains the relative signal strength of the return for the moving target. A value of 00 indicates a target with a very weak return signal while a value of 15 indicates a moving target with a very strong return signal; intermediate values are scaled accordingly. This field provides a coarse indication of the relative size of the moving target.

TGT_CAT.Name: Target Classification Category
TGT_CAT.Description: This field describes the target classification category. A value of H = Helicopter, T = Tracked, U = Unknown, and W = Wheeled.
